services.not_separable: Fastmail's API is JMAP: every mail operation (query, read, create a draft, send via EmailSubmission/set) is a method name inside one JSON body POSTed to the session's apiUrl (RFC 8620 section 3.1), so send vs read is split only by inspecting the JSON body, not by path or method. Blob upload and download have their own session URLs (RFC 8620 sections 6.1 and 6.2), but Fastmail's concrete uploadUrl/downloadUrl paths come from the session object at runtime and were not on any reachable Fastmail page.
services.web_ui_note: Whether the Fastmail web app itself talks JMAP to api.fastmail.com is not stated on any reachable page (www.fastmail.com/dev/ is blocked). RFC 8620 and 8621 are authored by N. Jenkins (Fastmail) but are standards, not a statement about Fastmail's web client.
